overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated performance metrics over the recent observation window indicates that high-concept space and astrophysics videos—specifically planetary extreme scenarios structured around 'What If You Fell Into...' or extreme environmental conditions (diamond planets, burning ice, dark planets, and unusual planetary rain)—generate significantly higher velocity (views-per-day) and superior engagement (likes-per-view and comments-per-view) compared to general psychological tricks or older archival facts. Videos published within the last 7 to 10 days consistently outperform older catalog items when leveraging high-stakes visual curiosity and counterintuitive cosmic phenomena.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) achieved over 970 to 1,024 views within days of release with exceptional like ratios.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on high-stakes hypothetical scenarios involving extreme alien worlds, exotic states of matter, and dangerous planetary environments.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) drove over 980 to 1,000+ views rapidly by shattering conventional expectations.
winning_patterns.action: Feature obscure astronomical bodies and strange physical laws that challenge basic human intuition within the first 3 seconds.

weak_patterns.evidence: Shorts covering common mental hacks or memory quirks (e.g., 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories', views in single digits to low 50s) showed near-zero comment velocity and poor like ratios.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard psychological tricks unless paired with a bizarre, high-concept neurological mystery or extreme sensory anomaly.

weak_patterns.pattern: Stale Animal Trivia Without Cinematic stakes
weak_patterns.evidence: Basic animal facts like octopuses having three hearts showed diminishing returns on repeat iterations compared to the dominant space content.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal-related content entirely toward cinematic survival or extreme evolutionary anomalies rather than basic static trivia.
